title: Online resume page
when: The user wants their CV or resume as a web page that also prints well.
prompt:
Goal: A clean resume page that reads in thirty seconds on screen and prints on one or two pages.
Steps:
1. Header with name, title, city and contact links (email, phone as tel).
2. A three line summary with the strongest facts.
3. Experience newest first: role, company, dates, and two to four bullets that start with a verb and show results.
4. Education, skills and languages as compact lists.
5. Add print styles: hide navigation and buttons, use black text, avoid page breaks inside a job.
Quality bar:
- Dates use one format.
- Bullets show impact with numbers when the user gave them.
- Prints cleanly from the browser.
Pitfalls:
- Inventing employers, dates or numbers the user did not give.
- Two column layouts that break in print.
- Photos or personal data the user did not ask to include.
Verify:
- [ ] Every job has role, company and dates.
- [ ] A @media print block exists.
- [ ] Links are real mailto and tel links.
- [ ] One h1 with the name.
Output: index.html and style.css with screen and print styles.

examples.input: turn my CV into a web page
examples.output: h1 with the name, summary, three jobs with result bullets, skills list, print styles
